description: This PHP source file provides the web interface for editing port forwarding rules, including form handling, validation scripts, and server-side code to populate and process port forwarding configurations.

methods.name: GetAddress
methods.description: Concatenates IPv6 address segments from inputs into a full address string.

methods.description: Determines if IPv6 address input is required based on current form state.
